title: The four actions framework
caption: Value innovation asks four questions about every factor the industry competes on. Cirque du Soleil eliminated animals and stars, reduced thrills, raised venue and artistry, and created themes and music.
alt: Four boxes: eliminate (animal shows, star performers), reduce (thrills and danger), raise (a unique venue, artistic quality), create (themes, artistic music and dance).
description: Eliminate: animal shows and star performers.
Raise: a unique venue and artistic quality.
Create: themes, artistic music and dance, attracting theatre-goers as well as families.
